responsibility: This .opt file declares the SDE-specific compatibility target options accepted by the MIPS port. Rather than introducing new backend state, it maps the legacy -mcode-xonly and -mno-data-in-code spellings onto the general -mcode-readable= option values used elsewhere in the backend, so its responsibility is option-parser aliasing for SDE command-line compatibility.
same_name_distinction: Compared with sde.h, this .opt file does not set SDE target policy through macros or specs; it only defines SDE compatibility aliases that map legacy options like -mcode-xonly and -mno-data-in-code onto the general -mcode-readable= settings.
